task_description:
# Advanced Conflict Analysis

Replace placeholder TODO checks in conflict analysis with real implementation. Provide semantic understanding of conflicts, not just line-based detection. Analyze code structure, variable renames, and functional changes.

## Rationale
Addresses known technical gap (placeholder TODOs in conflict analysis). Current placeholder implementation limits conflict resolution quality. Semantic analysis enables smarter resolutions and reduces developer intervention.

## User Stories
- As a developer, I want conflicts analyzed semantically so the AI makes smarter resolution choices
- As a developer, I want to understand why conflicts occurred so I can approve resolutions confidently

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Conflict analysis identifies semantic conflicts (not just line conflicts)
- [ ] Analysis provides context about conflicting changes (intent, scope)
- [ ] Resolution suggestions are ranked by confidence
- [ ] Handles complex scenarios: rename + modify, structural changes
- [ ] Tests verify correct handling of various conflict types
